body:
Follow-up to `robofab-scurve` (its "finer ramp-fraction grid" next step). A finer grid alone makes the trapezoid beat the time-optimal solver, because the 201-point torque check misses a 0.2% ramp. With ramp-resolved sampling the time-optimal edge at 2 and 1 rad/s is -0.3 to +0.9% (old figure 1.3 to 1.5%), and the solver's 400-node error (~0.5%) is as large as the edge. Stylised; only speed-limited rows re-run. 46 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
